def process(tokens):
    pairs = {'(': ')', '{': '}', '[': ']', '<': '>'}
    closers = set(pairs.values())
    stack = []
    for t in tokens:
        if t in pairs:
            stack.append(t)
        elif t in closers:
            if not stack or pairs[stack[-1]] != t:
                return None, stack
            stack.pop()
    return True, stack
